newsitem.title: UK: London Clubs says no change in bid deadline.
newsitem.headline: London Clubs says no change in bid deadline.

text.p: Britain's London Clubs International Plc, responding to a newspaper report, said on Thursday there had been no change in the timetable for its hostile 196 million stg bid for gaming firm Capital Corp Plc.

The Financial Times quoted London Clubs chief executive Alan Goodenough as saying the company was considering shortening the deadline for acceptances of its bid to avoid clashing with the British election on May 1.
"We don't want to be competing with (Prime Minister) John Major, so we may cut a few days off the end of it," he was quoted as saying.
Under the normal 60-day bid timetable, the final date for acceptances of the offer would be May 3.
"London Clubs would like to clarify that the offer for Capital Corp has not been declared final and that no change has been made to the normal offer timetable," the firm said in a statement.
